title: Analysis of Human Tooth Enamel Crystals by Electron Microscopy
content: Human tooth enamel crystals are shaped like parallelepipeds with dimensions of 50 nm wide and 100 to 200 nm long [1]. However, in the study of human tooth enamel we have observed the existence of at least two morphologies of the grains that make it up. Some grains have a prismatic-like shape while others have “flake”-like shapes [2]. This difference in morphology may be due to the coexistence of two crystalline structures in tooth enamel with different space groups.
